notes.title: Update has been released!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː

Hi friends,

We've just updated this great game!
Now you may play it on Mac OS X!
Also the support for the following languages was added:
Dutch, Japanese and Ukrainian

Hope you are enjoying it! ːsteamhappyː
